digest.en: US strikes on Iranian fast boats and Iran's attacks on a UAE oil facility dominate headlines. OPEC+ has raised oil production quotas without addressing the UAE's potential pull-out. Tensions in the Strait of Hormuz and Gulf region threaten a fragile US-Iran ceasefire.
digest.hi: अमेरिकी राष्ट्रपति डोनाल्ड ट्रंप ने ईरान को चेतावनी दी है कि अगर उसने अमेरिकी जहाजों पर हमला किया तो दुनिया के नक्शे से मिटा देंगे। ईरान और अमेरिका के बीच बढ़ते तनाव के बीच यह बयान आया है। ईरान ने अमेरिकी युद्धपोत पर मिसाइल हमला किया था।

articles.title: US strikes Iranian fast boats as Iran attacks UAE oil facility

articles.title: Meta taps Morgan Stanley, JPMorgan for El Paso data center deal, Bloomberg News reports

articles.title: OPEC+ Hikes Oil Production Quotas Without Mentioning UAE Pull-Out
articles.summary: OPEC+ increased oil production quotas without addressing the United Arab Emirates' reported pull-out. The group's untapped reserves are mainly located in the Gulf region. Untapped OPEC+ reserves are mainly located in the Gulf region.

articles.title: Attacks in Strait of Hormuz, Gulf region imperil fragile U.S.-Iran ceasefire
articles.summary: Recent attacks in the Strait of Hormuz and the Gulf region threaten a fragile US-Iran ceasefire. The incidents have raised concerns about the stability of the region. Attacks in Strait of Hormuz, Gulf region imperil fragile U. S.-Iran ceasefire The Washington Post.

articles.title: The US fights to reopen the Strait of Hormuz as the UAE comes under attack in a test of Iran truce
articles.summary: The US military is working to reopen the Strait of Hormuz after the United Arab Emirates came under attack, testing a truce with Iran. The US is seeking to restore shipping through the strategic waterway.

articles.title: Armed man shot by U.S. Secret Service near White House
articles.summary: A man was shot by the U. S. Secret Service near the White House, shortly after Vice-President J. D. Vance's motorcade passed by. The incident occurred near the National Mall. The U. S. Secret Service Deputy Director Matthew Quinn confirmed the details.

articles.title: Zelenskyy rallies partners on defence, sanctions and diplomacy at EPC summit
articles.summary: Ukrainian President Zelenskyy rallied partners on defence, sanctions, and diplomacy at the European Political Community summit. He urged collective action against Russia. The summit aimed to strengthen unity among European nations.

articles.title: World Must Hold U.S. Responsible for Making Strait of Hormuz Unsafe
articles.summary: Iran stated that the world must hold the U. S. responsible for making the Strait of Hormuz unsafe. The U. S. presence in the region was deemed a threat. Iran's stance was reported by iranpress. com.

articles.title: Hormuz tensions push ceasefire to the brink as Trump threatens Iran
articles.summary: The US encouraged ships to pass through the Hormuz Strait despite Iran's control claims. Trump threatened Iran over the situation. US military says it is encouraging ships to pass through Hormuz Strait, but Iran says it is in full control of waterway.

articles.title: Is Israel’s interception of the Global Sumud Flotilla legal?
articles.summary: Spain condemned Israel's detention of two activists from the Global Sumud Flotilla as an abduction. The incident raised questions about Israel's interception of the flotilla. The Spanish government expressed its disapproval.

articles.title: Modi’s BJP poised to take control in India’s West Bengal
articles.summary: India's Prime Minister Narendra Modi's ruling BJP is poised to gain control of West Bengal. The BJP's expected victory marks a significant shift in the state's politics. Modi's party is likely to wrest control from the current ruling party.

articles.title: Russia and Ukraine declare competing ceasefires
articles.summary: Russia declared a May 9 truce, while Ukraine claimed its adversary fears Ukrainian drones. Moscow's declaration of May 9 truce comes as Kyiv revels in its adversary's 'fear' of Ukrainian drones.

articles.title: Police clash with protesters after ICE arrest in New York
articles.summary: New York police clashed with protesters outside a hospital where a man arrested by ICE agents was being treated. The incident occurred on a busy street in Manhattan. Police clashed with protesters outside a New York hospital where a man arrested by ICE agents was being treated.

articles.title: Why U.S. troops are stationed in Germany, and what happens if some leave
articles.summary: US troops are stationed in Germany, with potential moves elsewhere under discussion. NPR's Mary Louise Kelly talks with Jeff Rathke, president of the American-German Institute, about U. S. troops stationed in Germany, and what happens if President Trump moves some of them elsewhere.

articles.summary: Elon Musk's trust will pay a $1.5 million civil penalty to settle a case over his Twitter stake. The payment resolves a dispute over Musk's ownership of the social media platform.

articles.title: Moscow rehearses V-Day parade marking WWII victory
articles.summary: Russia rehearsed its Victory Day parade and declared a ceasefire with Ukraine. Moscow rehearses V-Day parade marking WWII victory.

articles.title: Trump Obsesses Over Ballroom as Iran War Ceasefire Unravels
articles.summary: A ceasefire in the Iran war is unraveling, amid other concerns. Trump Obsesses Over Ballroom as Iran War Ceasefire Unravels The Daily Beast.

articles.summary: The New York Times won three Pulitzer awards, while Reuters took home two prizes in the 2025 ceremony. The Associated Press also received recognition in the journalism awards. The New York Times won three of the coveted prizes, Reuters won two Pulitzer awards.

articles.title: Modi's party takes control of India's West Bengal in key state election
articles.summary: Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi's Bharatiya Janata Party took control of West Bengal in a key state election, strengthening Modi's political position midway through his third term. The outcome is expected to strengthen Modi's political position midway through his third term.
